import asyncio


class Queue:
    def __init__(self):
        self.pending = set()

    async def drain(self):
        while self.pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*self.pending)


async def drain_local(pending):
    while pending:
        await asyncio.gather(*pending)


async def drain_list(pending):
    while pending:
        await asyncio.gather(*list(pending))


async def other_collection(a, b):
    while a:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*b)


async def second_statement(a):
    count = 0
    while a:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*a)
        count += 1


async def one_item(a):
    while a:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await a[0]


async def one_from_queue(queue):
    while queue:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(process(queue.pop()))


async def one_part(queue):
    while queue:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*[process(item) for item in queue[:1]])


async def drain_keeping_errors(pending):
    while pending:
        await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
